question: A can do (1)/(5) of a piece of work in 20 days, B can do 30% of the same work in 36 days, while C can do 80% of the same work in 160 days. B and C together started and worked for x days. After x days B left the work, and A joined C and both completed the remaining work in (x - 41) days. If the ratio between the work done by (B + C) together to the work done by (A + C) together is 19 ∶ 6, then what fraction of the same work can be completed by C alone in 2x days?

After x days, B left work, and A joined with C.

(A + C) completed the remaining in (x - 41) days. 

(B + C) : (A + C) = 19 : 6

**Calculation:**

A complete the work = 20 / (1/5) = 20 × 5 = 100 days

B complete the work = 36/3 × 100 = 120 days

C complete the work = 160/8 × 100 = 200 days

Total work = LCM of (100, 120, 200) = 600

According to the question,

⇒ 600 = (B+C)x + (A+C)(x-41)

⇒ 600 = 8x + 9(x-41)

⇒ 600 = 17x - 369

⇒ 17x = 600 + 369

⇒ x = 969/17 = 57

Now, In 2x days, C completes the work per day.

⇒ (2x)/(600)× efficiency 

⇒ (2×57)/(600)× 3 = (57)/(100)

**∴ C alone can complete (57)/(100)of the work in 2x days.**
